name: Airtable
shortInfo: The Airtable connector enables streaming data from a user's warehouse to the Airtable platform.
brief: Airtable is a cloud-based platform for creating and sharing relational databases. The user-friendly interface allows anyone to spin up a database in minutes.
about: Airtable is an AI-native app platform that enables users to build custom business applications through conversational interactions with its AI assistant, Omni. The platform combines structured data management with AI-powered app generation, allowing users to create production-ready applications by describing what they need in natural language
availableSync:
[Table Report](https://docs.datachannel.co/getting-started/1.0.0/reverse_etl/destinations_retl/airtable/syncs/table-report.html)

This sync can be used to upload data in table form with the specified fields from a user specified data warehouse to the Airtable Platform.
